claim_verdicts.evidence: Definitional: restates glossary test-pyramid short_en ('A suite shape with many unit tests, fewer integration tests and very few tests of the whole running system') and outline item 1. No versions.yaml docs root covers the concept; no named source attributed.

Conceptual premise of the pyramid, presented without a version-dependent behaviour. Consistent with execution in this repo: unit Duration 90 ms with no containers vs integration Duration 2 s plus PostgreSQL/Redis/Ryuk containers and ~16 s wall.

OrderTests.cs @ stage-2 has Cancel_ShippedOrder_Throws, Cancel_CancelledOrder_Throws, Ship_NewOrder_Throws, MarkPaid_PaidOrder_Throws etc.; OrdersApiTests.cs has exactly one 409 test, ShipOrder_StaffAndNewOrder_Returns409NotPaid, asserting HttpStatusCode.Conflict and Type "https://donhang.local/problems/not-paid". Lesson correctly avoids 'every' (OrderTests has no MarkPaid-on-cancelled or Ship-on-shipped test).

Round-1 run, not-paid line deleted from Entities.cs Ship(): 'Failed DonHang.Tests.Domain.OrderTests.Ship_NewOrder_Throws [3 ms] / Assert.Throws() Failure: No exception was thrown', 'Failed: 1, Passed: 9 ... Duration: 90 ms'; OrdersApiTests: 'Expected: Conflict / Actual: OK', 'Failed: 1, Passed: 4'. Sec 4 now contrasts failure causes (only Order.Ship() vs rule/routing/StaffOnly/middleware/database), which this code supports: Ship_NewOrder_Throws runs only Order; the 409 test goes through OrdersController.Ship [Authorize(Policy="StaffOnly")], the middleware and PostgreSQL.

Lesson's guideline (outline item 3), now conditioned on where the risk sits. Supporting fact holds for this code: Order has no dependencies (NewOrder() = new(customerId: 1, OneItem(), DateTimeOffset.UtcNow)), so an OrderTests failure can only come from Order; 'HTTP contract' is now glossed in sec 3 as status code, headers and body, matching the OrdersApiTests.cs:10-12 comment.

Conditional opinion ('When an application mostly moves data ... is a reasonable choice'), exactly the opposing view DECISIONS 2026-09-27 integration-testing (9) requires; no person or 'testing trophy' named, no ratio.

OrderTests.cs:96-105 @ stage-2: NewOrder(); Assert.Throws<OrderStatusException>(order.Ship); Assert.Equal("not-paid", ex.Code); Assert.Equal("new", order.Status). NewOrder() is new(customerId: 1, OneItem(), DateTimeOffset.UtcNow): no DbContext, no container, no HTTP.

ExceptionHandlingMiddleware.cs @ stage-2: 'catch (OrderStatusException ex) ... WriteProblemAsync(context, StatusCodes.Status409Conflict, ..., type: ProblemTypeBase + ex.Code, ...)' with ProblemTypeBase = "https://donhang.local/problems/". OrdersController.Ship has [Authorize(Policy = "StaffOnly")]; the test client sends roles 'staff'.

OrdersApiTests.cs @ stage-2 has 5 tests: PostOrder_SignedInCustomer_Returns201WithLocation, PostOrder_NoCaller_Returns401, GetOrder_AnotherCustomersOrder_Returns403, ShipOrder_Customer_Returns403, ShipOrder_StaffAndNewOrder_Returns409NotPaid; none for already-shipped/already-cancelled. OrderTests has Cancel_ShippedOrder_Throws (already-shipped) and Cancel_CancelledOrder_Throws (already-cancelled).
ProductsController.cs:10-15 @ stage-2: '// The list reads DonHangDbContext directly: it has no rule to apply, only a / query to shape.' and List builds 'IQueryable<Product> query = db.Products;'.
Opinion consistent with DECISIONS 2026-09-27 integration-testing (9) (no fixed ratio); stated as the lesson's view of a picture, no number asserted.

ApiFactory.cs @ stage-2: InitializeAsync awaits Database.InitializeAsync() (PostgresFixture) then redis.StartAsync() before the app builds. Round-1 docker events for the OrdersApiTests filter: testcontainers/ryuk:0.14.0, then postgres:17.6-alpine, then redis:8.10.2-alpine created. Sec 7 wording 'starts its PostgreSQL and Redis containers first' matches; the ledger's note on the helper container covers Ryuk.

ExceptionHandlingMiddleware.cs @ stage-2 maps every OrderStatusException to 409 with type ProblemTypeBase + ex.Code, so one 409 test covers the shared path (opinion, conditioned on that fact). ApiFactory: WebApplicationFactory<Program> 'Runs DonHang.Api's own Program.cs inside the test process'; TestAuthHandler 'builds the caller from two request headers instead of from a Keycloak token'. git ls-tree: no DonHang.Tests file runs a deployed app. scripts/k8s/smoke-test.sh exists but only does an anonymous GET /api/v1/products without Keycloak, so it is not one by the sec 3 definition.
